evidence_kind: bounded human-observed screenshots/AX results after native mouse-helper input; AX actions distinguished below

results.observed: One-line title, opaque toolbar without managed-placeholder bleed, readable Find field. AX Next changed page 1/2 to 2/2; Find page one returned to page 1/2; selected result remained visible after Zoom/Fit.

First drag retained only the earlier search selection and failed the full-line comparison; clipboard restored. Retry from the left text margin selected the full fixture line. fixture_text_copied=true and original_clipboard_restored=true. No preexisting clipboard content or format data recorded.
Native Command-F then Tab left PDF for the Components selector; Shift-Tab returned to the PDF selection. Exhaustive traversal and human usability remain unqualified.
Managed component and native PDF toolbar used Dark appearance; PDF paper remained white and loaded source/selection persisted. Global OS appearance unchanged.

Initial container-centred attempt was occluded by raised Finder and left state unchanged. Helper retargeted visible file button and raised destination during drag. Path became /private/tmp/vellum-integration-fixtures/reference.txt, Reveal/Clear enabled, status Path accepted and action count 1 to 2. No application code change required.

Native mouse click completed Croissants (r1), Groceries 6 to 5, completed 1 to 2, Undo enabled. AX Undo restored the same r1 unchecked, Groceries 6 and completed 1; AX Redo removed it from active rows again, Groceries 5 and completed 2. Final screenshot showed the Redo state. A final batched Undo/Scheduled AX attempt had no observed change and is not counted as evidence.
Focused model/routing/offscreen tests passed at checkpoint 3, including pending-input settlement and calendar guards. Not physically requalified in final package.

See interactions.md for physical media play/seek/volume, two calendar clicks with accepted range, Browse and Finder Reveal. Unchanged interaction implementations reused; these were not rerun in final package.

delivery: Both exact packaged apps launched and left running. Reminders is fictional/in-memory; no user notebook or Apple Reminders data accessed.
limitations: Other hardware, exhaustive keyboard traversal and every native content combination are unqualified.
Offscreen capture excludes embedded native pixels; arbitrary managed popover overlap remains unsupported.
Media paths are mutable and OS decoder resource cost is not hard-capped.
Ad-hoc signed, unnotarized private delivery; no public release publication.
